summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. filed a Canadian Form 6-K furnishing a Report of Voting Results under National Instrument 51-102, the Canadian equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K. At an October 14, 2026 special meeting, unitholders holding 275,237,544 units, or 60.13% of the 457,714,670 outstanding, approved BIP Transaction Resolutions including the BIP Arrangement Resolution and BIP LPA Amendment Resolution. Each measure passed with roughly 99.5% support from all units and minority unitholders. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed.
